location: Queen Elizabeth II Road, Oritamefa, Ibadan, Oyo State, Nigeria

gates.name: Main Gate (Queen Elizabeth II Road)
gates.notes: Two vehicular lanes separated by a central security island, overhead cantilever gate signage, pedestrian side gates.

gates.name: East Gate (School of Nursing Road)
gates.notes: Direct entry to schools, student hostels, and eastern services.

architectural_language.primary_complex: Tropical modernist mid-century clinical complex designed in the 1950s. Deep projecting concrete overhangs, white and warm sand rendered walls, horizontal sun louver panels (brise-soleil) for passive cooling.
architectural_language.landscape: Extensive mature tropical trees (flamboyant, mahogany, neem, royal palms), manicured lawn verges along Queen Elizabeth Road frontage and inner courtyards.
